source_documents.title: Electronic and Geometric Characterization of TICT Formation in Hemithioindigo Photoswitches by Picosecond Infrared Spectroscopy

reference_evidence_units.quote: HTI 3 serves as a control compound, which bears the same electron-rich stilbene part as 1, yet is not pretwisted in the ground state and thus does not undergo TICT formation in any solvent.
reference_evidence_units.subject: HTI Z-3
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Planar comparator versus pretwisted HTI Z-1 and Z-2.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source uses non-pretwisted Z-3 as a negative TICT control.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The claim applies to solvents tested and is not evidence of aggregation or RIM turn-on in Z-1.

reference_evidence_units.quote: HTI Z-1 was dissolved in dCH, dDCM, and dDMSO
reference_evidence_units.subject: HTI Z-1
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Transient IR; 1.0-2.5 mg/mL deuterated solvents; pump 460-500 nm, magic-angle setup.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Z-1 was studied across apolar and polar solvents, with optical preparation of the Z state.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Concentration is the stated experimental range, not a solvent-specific concentration.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Z-1 and Z-2 show no spectral evolution of the initial excited-state spectrum toward new excited-state species in the apolar solvent dCH.
reference_evidence_units.subject: HTI Z-1 and Z-2
reference_evidence_units.statement: No evolution into a new excited-state spectral species is detected in dCH; decay and E photoproduct formation are reported.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No aggregation series is present; lack of TICT is condition-specific.

reference_evidence_units.quote: 210 ps for Z-1 and 32 ps for Z-2 in dDCM.
reference_evidence_units.subject: HTI Z-1 and Z-2
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Global IR kinetic analysis in dDCM; Figure 3 visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Reported TICT decay is about 210 ps for Z-1, versus about 32 ps for Z-2.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: These are different compounds, not interchangeable lifetimes; values are rounded in prose.

reference_evidence_units.quote: For Z-1, in dDCM (see Figure 3a,c), the C−O band shows a qualitatively similar behavior
reference_evidence_units.subject: HTI Z-1
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Transient IR band near 1515 cm-1 in dDCM.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The main text reports about 5 cm-1 shift with about 3 ps time constant, and amplitude maximum after about 30 ps.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Assignment is analogous to Z-2 rather than independently calculated for Z-1.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Kinetic Data Describing the Excited-State Processes for HTIs Z-1, Z-2, and Z-3 in Diﬀerent Solvents
reference_evidence_units.subject: HTI Z-1
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Table 2 visually inspected; colored time-constant assignments.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Table 2 gives Z-1 TICT lifetimes of 210.6 ps in dDCM and 17.8 ps in dDMSO; shift-time entries are 2.8 and 1.9 ps, respectively.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Caption anchors the visually read table; dCH 11.9 ps component is not marked TICT. The table header labels the shift column cm-1 although prose describes its entries as time constants; unit ambiguity retained.

reference_evidence_units.quote: We only focused on the Z-2 derivative as TICT forming species and neglected Z-1 in the calculations
reference_evidence_units.subject: HTI Z-2 and Z-3
reference_evidence_units.conditions: CASSCF/CASPT2 reaction pathways and TDDFT marker-band calculations.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The computational conical-intersection pathways and quantitative dipoles belong to Z-2/Z-3, not target Z-1.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No Z-1 CI geometry, dipole magnitude or state energy is transferred.

reference_evidence_units.quote: identification of the C−O marker band was not corroborated by quantum chemical calculations
reference_evidence_units.subject: HTI Z-1
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source acknowledges that full Z-1 transient band assignment was not possible and assumes analogous behavior to Z-2.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This explicit uncertainty bounds the otherwise supported TICT interpretation.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Solvent relaxation induced by the significant change in the dipole of the molecule for the TICT state could also contribute to the spectral shift
reference_evidence_units.subject: TICT-forming HTI derivatives
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Discussion of picosecond spectral shifts in polar solvents.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors retain solvent relaxation as a possible contributor to the evolving IR shift.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The shift is not treated as a uniquely geometric measure.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Time-resolved polar/apolar contrasts support the authors' TICT assignment for Z-1, bounded by analog-based marker assignment and solvent-relaxation ambiguity.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific restriction of internal motion established in this extraction; AIE or rigidity alone is not sufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific packing, host or matrix mechanism established for the selected conditions.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No guest-binding or inclusion mechanism linked to target emission established; solvent polarity alone does not establish host-guest binding.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Time-resolved polar/apolar contrasts support the authors' TICT assignment for Z-1, bounded by analog-based marker assignment and solvent-relaxation ambiguity.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer mechanism established; hydrogen bonding or ground-state acid-base chemistry alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No separate photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on established; intramolecular CT is not automatically PET.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Aggregation alone does not establish excitonic coupling, H/J aggregation, excimer or exciplex emission.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Transient-state lifetimes alone do not isolate an emission-rate mechanism for Z-1.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific triplet, metal-centered or energy-transfer emissive mechanism established in the selected conditions.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Conical intersections are computed for Z-2/Z-3, not Z-1; target CI access is not established.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No emission from higher excited states or suppression of Kasha's rule established.
